response.sql:
WITH scope_counts AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u
    ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT
  acctscope,
  order_count,
  CAST(order_count AS REAL) / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total,
  CAST(order_count AS REAL) / AVG(order_count) OVER () AS count_over_average_scope_count
FROM scope_counts;

assumptions.assumption: Each matching risk/margin record contributes one matched order, so an order with multiple matching risk/margin records is counted once per record. The average is across scopes present among matched records.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct orders within each scope, so multiple matching risk/margin records for the same order count once.
alternatives.sql:
WITH scope_counts AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u
    ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT
  acctscope,
  order_count,
  CAST(order_count AS REAL) / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total,
  CAST(order_count AS REAL) / AVG(order_count) OVER () AS count_over_average_scope_count
FROM scope_counts;
